summary: PulseGuard v0.6.14 fixes the v0.6.13 responsive-driver result handoff, exposes exact driver update status, makes the automatic post-fix rescan unmistakably visible, and repairs full-screen driver-page clipping.

sections.heading: Responsive Driver FixAll result handoff repaired
sections.detail: The detached driver worker now returns a PSCustomObject transport payload and the parent reads it through dictionary-safe accessors, preventing a successful driver run from being misreported as “worker did not report success.”

sections.heading: Exact driver update status is visible
sections.detail: Drivers / Devices now separates Device Manager health from driver-update state and lists the exact Windows Update, OEM, or Microsoft Catalog package/device that is available, installed, verified, or failed when the provider exposes that detail.

sections.heading: Automatic post-fix Full Health Rescan stays visibly active
sections.detail: FIX + OPTIMIZE ALL no longer paints the final completion state before its automatic rescan starts. The Optimize page remains in an explicit POST-FIX FULL HEALTH RESCAN state with live progress until the background diagnostic finishes and refreshes the final baseline.

sections.heading: Drivers page now fits full screen correctly
sections.detail: The Device Manager grid shrinks when there are no errors, the combined driver-status panel gets a stable readable area, and the signed-driver inventory dynamically fills the remaining visible client height with a protected bottom margin on maximize/restore/DPI resize.

sections.heading: v0.6.13 safety/reporting improvements retained
sections.detail: Game Ready app-family reconciliation, direct startup/registry verification, actionable CPU comparison, and the responsive background driver execution model remain in place.
